invariants.claim: On successful return, the new ID and clone are registered bidirectionally and isRaffle is true.
End time is strictly future and at most 30 days ahead; reserve is positive.
Creation returns only after the prize reports the clone owner and the clone reports Active.
Factory nested creation is rejected by its instance guard; registry publication precedes prize transfer.

assumptions.claim: Clone target contains the intended fixed implementation; Clones does not check code (Clones.sol:L28-L30).
assumptions.establishedBy: target/packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L89-L91 deploys and stores the immutable implementation; Clones.sol:L54-L57 embeds it.

assumptions.claim: Clone initialization is once-only and factory-only, and screens sponsor, treasury and recipient including the new clone itself.
Actual transfer enforces sponsor ownership and factory approval; ownership reports truthfully describe an honest persistent prize ledger (factory call/check at L128-L134).
Active means the configured prize caller supplied matching token ID, sponsor and factory callback arguments while AwaitingPrize.
